meta.note: vara 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday, reckoned from local sunrise (varaAt). For the garbhadhana profile this component is INFORMATIONAL — it is displayed with its citation but carries zero weight, because the requirement's 100-point split (§5.2 of the master plan) has no vara slot. Other categories may weight it.

translations.en: Sunday — the Sun's day; krura (harsh) in nature.
translations.hi: रविवार — सूर्य का वार; क्रूर स्वभाव।

rules.interpretation: Suited to acts of authority and medicine; the harsh solar quality is not sought for a nourishing samskara.

translations.en: Monday — the Moon's day; saumya (gentle), favourable.
translations.hi: सोमवार — चन्द्र का वार; सौम्य, अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: The Moon governs the mind and conception; its own day is naturally supportive.

translations.en: Tuesday — Mars's day; krura, generally avoided.
translations.hi: मंगलवार — मंगल का वार; क्रूर, सामान्यत: वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Mars is fierce and impatient; his day is set aside for auspicious domestic rites.

translations.en: Wednesday — Mercury's day; saumya and favourable.
translations.hi: बुधवार — बुध का वार; सौम्य व अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Mercury is a natural benefic when unafflicted; his day supports intelligent, well-formed beginnings.

translations.en: Thursday — Jupiter's day; best of the weekdays for progeny.
translations.hi: गुरुवार — बृहस्पति का वार; सन्तान हेतु श्रेष्ठ।

rules.interpretation: Jupiter is the karaka of progeny; his weekday is the first choice for this samskara.

translations.en: Friday — Venus's day; saumya, favours conjugal life.
translations.hi: शुक्रवार — शुक्र का वार; सौम्य, दाम्पत्य हेतु अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Venus is the karaka of marriage and of the reproductive fluid (shukra); his day is strongly favourable.

translations.en: Saturday — Saturn's day; krura, generally avoided.
translations.hi: शनिवार — शनि का वार; क्रूर, सामान्यत: वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Saturn delays and restricts; his day is avoided for rites whose aim is timely fruition.
